decisions.reason: The guided client-operated workflow applies to keywords and KDP uploading; it does not change the required back matter or author biography content.
The source changes how keywords and uploading will be performed, not the cover design, trim size, preferred cover, or unresolved cover choice.
The client-operated KDP workflow does not alter the publication attribution line on the copyright page.
The assistance-mode change does not alter the paperback format or 6 x 9 inch trim size.
Guidance for keywords and KDP uploading has no necessary effect on Chapter 18 heading typography.
The source does not change chapter-image aspect ratio, cropping, or pixelation requirements.
The KDP guidance workflow does not change the authoritative manuscript file, approved passages, tracked edits, or table punctuation.
The client-operated keyword and upload workflow does not modify the manuscript copyediting or proofreading requirements.
